texts.preamble: Munnu vs State And Others on 12 September, 2019 Author: Sudhir Agarwal Bench: Sudhir Agarwal High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad ?Court No. - 34 Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 1555 of 1988 Revisionist :- Munnu Opposite Party :- State And Others Counsel for Revisionist :- N.N. Singh,Achyuta Nand Pandey Counsel for Opposite Party :- A.G.A. Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J. 1.
texts.arguments: 3. Learned counsel for revisionist confined his argument only to the question of imprisonment stating that considering the advance age of revisionist, the sentence of imprisonment may be reduced to the period already undergone. On the contrary, I find that minimum punishment prescribed under Statute has been awarded, and hence the same cannot be reduced as held by Apex Court recent in State of Madhya Pradesh vs. Vikram Das (2019) 4 SCC 125 observing as under: ?? where minimum sentence is provided for, the Court cannot impose less than the minimum sentence.? 6.
